findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler does not implement the new abstract methods
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler, which declares four abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data). None of them are implemented, so the class is still abstract; Detector.detector_handler (which calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`) will raise TypeError at instantiation for any detector of type "metric_alert_fire". Previously the class implemented `evaluate` and was instantiable. Either implement the methods or leave a concrete placeholder implementation.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate says "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but the method's signature and the PR's contract change it to return a dict keyed by DetectorGroupKey. The docstring was not updated and now misdescribes the API.

findings.title: Multi-group test constructs expected occurrence with wrong value
findings.body: In test_state_results_multi_group, the data packet has group_vals {"group_1": 6, "group_2": 10}, but the expected occurrence for group_2 is built via build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "group_2", 6, ...) using 6 instead of 10. The test passes only because the mock builder ignores `value`; if the builder or implementation starts using the value, this expectation is wrong and would silently mask a value-propagation bug between evaluate_group_key_value and build_occurrence_and_event_data. The expected value should be 10, and ideally the mock builder should include `value` in evidence_data so the propagation is actually asserted.
